description: Scaffold a React 18 + Vite 5 + TypeScript 5 SPA in-place under frontend/ (authored BY HAND because the sandbox cannot reach the npm registry), and wire up the build/deploy plumbing: env-var injection (VITE_*), a shared typed API client mirroring the exact backend contract, a runtime config module, client-side routing shell, gitignore, amplify.yml, and README updates. This feature establishes a coherent, buildable project skeleton with a working app shell; the rich UI for the two flows is implemented in FEAT-002. Independent of no other feature; FEAT-002 depends on this.
steps: Create frontend/package.json (a NEW project, separate from the root CDK package.json). name 'quiz-app-frontend', private true, type 'module'. scripts: dev='vite', build='tsc -b && vite build', preview='vite preview'. dependencies: react ^18.3.1, react-dom ^18.3.1, react-router-dom ^6.26.0. devDependencies: @types/react ^18.3.3, @types/react-dom ^18.3.0, @types/node ^22.5.0, @vitejs/plugin-react ^4.3.1, typescript ~5.5.4, vite ^5.4.0. Do NOT add a lockfile.

Create frontend/vite.config.ts: import { defineConfig } from 'vite' and react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'; export default defineConfig({ plugins: [react()], build: { outDir: 'dist' } }). Default root is frontend/, output frontend/dist.

Create frontend/tsconfig.json (app config) with references to ./tsconfig.node.json, and frontend/tsconfig.node.json (for vite.config). App tsconfig: target ES2020, lib [ES2020, DOM, DOM.Iterable], module ESNext, moduleResolution Bundler, jsx react-jsx, strict true, noEmit true, isolatedModules true, esModuleInterop true, skipLibCheck true, include ['src']. node tsconfig: composite true, module ESNext, moduleResolution Bundler, allowSyntheticDefaultImports true, include ['vite.config.ts']. Ensure `tsc -b` succeeds by having project references correct.

Create frontend/index.html at the Vite root (frontend/index.html): , , meta charset + viewport, クイズアプリ, a
, and . This REPLACES the old vanilla index.html.

Create frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts with /// <reference types="vite/client" /> and an ImportMetaEnv interface declaring readonly VITE_API_BASE?: string; VITE_COGNITO_DOMAIN?: string; VITE_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID?: string; and ImportMeta { readonly env: ImportMetaEnv }.

Create frontend/src/config.ts exporting: API_BASE = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE && it !== '' ? it : '/api').replace(/\/$/, ''); COGNITO_DOMAIN = (import.meta.env.VITE_COGNITO_DOMAIN ?? '').replace(/\/$/, ''); COGNITO_CLIENT_ID = import.meta.env.VITE_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID ?? ''. Mirror the trailing-slash-strip and empty-default '/api' semantics from the old app.js/admin.js exactly.

Create frontend/src/api.ts: a typed API client. Define TS interfaces matching lambda/index.ts EXACTLY: QuizSummary {quizId; title; questionCount}; QuizListResponse {quizzes: QuizSummary[]}; PublicQuestion {n; text; options: string[]}; QuizDetail {quizId; title; questions: PublicQuestion[]}; SubmitResult {quizId; score; total; results: {n; correct; answerIndex}[]}; AdminQuestionInput {text; options: string[]; answerIndex}; CreateQuizInput {title; questions: AdminQuestionInput[]; quizId?}; CreateQuizResponse {quizId; title; questionCount}. Implement fetchJson(path, options) that fetches API_BASE+path, throws Error('リクエストに失敗しました (' + status + ')') when !res.ok, and guards content-type includes 'application/json' else throws the exact Japanese 'API から予期しない応答を受け取りました（JSON ではありません）...' message (mirror app.js). Export: getQuizzes(), getQuiz(quizId), submitAnswers(quizId, answers: number[]), and createQuiz(input, idToken) which POSTs with Authorization: 'Bearer '+idToken and mirrors admin.js status handling (401 -> throw a typed AuthError so the UI clears the token + re-login; 403 -> Error('権限がありません'); parse JSON body for {message} on other non-ok; if body not JSON on non-ok, throw the 'unexpected non-JSON' message). Use encodeURIComponent on quizId in paths.

Create frontend/src/auth.ts: Cognito Hosted UI implicit-grant helpers mirroring admin.js EXACTLY. STORAGE_KEY='quizAdminToken'. adminPageUrl() = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname. loginUrl() = COGNITO_DOMAIN + '/login?client_id=' + encodeURIComponent(COGNITO_CLIENT_ID) + '&response_type=token&scope=openid+email+profile&redirect_uri=' + encodeURIComponent(adminPageUrl()). logoutUrl() = COGNITO_DOMAIN + '/logout?client_id=' + encodeURIComponent(COGNITO_CLIENT_ID) + '&logout_uri=' + encodeURIComponent(adminPageUrl()). restoreToken() reads sessionStorage {idToken, expiresAt} and returns it if Date.now() < expiresAt else removes it. saveToken(idToken, expiresAt). clearToken(). captureTokenFromHash() parses window.location.hash (strip leading #) with URLSearchParams, reads id_token/expires_in/error; on token sets expiresAt = Date.now() + (seconds - 60)*1000 with seconds defaulting to 3600 when missing/invalid, saves it, and returns {idToken, expiresAt, error?}; strips the fragment via history.replaceState(null,'', adminPageUrl()+window.location.search) when a token or error was present. Guard all sessionStorage access in try/catch (env may block it).

Create frontend/src/main.tsx: React 18 createRoot rendering <React.StrictMode><RouterProvider .../> or <BrowserRouter><App/></BrowserRouter>. Use react-router-dom v6 BrowserRouter with routes: '/' -> HomePage (public quiz flow, placeholder in this feature), '/admin' -> AdminPage (placeholder in this feature). Import the global stylesheet frontend/src/styles.css.

Create frontend/src/App.tsx with <Routes> mapping '/' and '/admin' to the two page components (created as minimal placeholders that render a heading + a link between them in this feature; full UI in FEAT-002). Create frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx and frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx as minimal shells for now.

Create frontend/src/styles.css: a modern, responsive base stylesheet. Port and modernize the CSS custom properties from the old frontend/styles.css (--bg/--card/--primary/--text/--muted/--correct/--incorrect etc.), add a dark-mode via prefers-color-scheme, card layout primitives, buttons, and layout container. This is the design foundation FEAT-002 builds the rich UI on.

Create frontend/.env.example documenting the three client env vars: VITE_API_BASE, VITE_COGNITO_DOMAIN, VITE_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID with example values and a comment that local dev copies this to .env.local.

Update root .gitignore: remove/replace the stale '!frontend/' and '!frontend/**' force-un-ignore block and the 'plain JS shipped to S3/CloudFront' comment. Add: frontend/node_modules, frontend/dist, frontend/*.local, frontend/.env.local (keep .env.example tracked). Ensure the NEW frontend source (src/, index.html, package.json, configs, .env.example) remains tracked and nothing needed is ignored.

Update root amplify.yml for the Vite build. frontend phases: preBuild commands = cd frontend && (generate frontend/.env from Amplify env vars, mapping API_BASE->VITE_API_BASE, COGNITO_DOMAIN->VITE_COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID->VITE_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID via a heredoc) && npm ci (or npm install if no lockfile). build commands = cd frontend && npm run build. artifacts baseDirectory = frontend/dist, files ['**/*']. cache paths = ['frontend/node_modules/**/*']. Update the Japanese comments to describe the npm build and VITE_* mapping. Keep the SAME Amplify env-var names (API_BASE/COGNITO_DOMAIN/COGNITO_CLIENT_ID) so the user does not have to reconfigure the console; the mapping to VITE_* happens in the build step.

Update root README.md (Japanese): update the frontend description from 'バニラ JS / ビルド不要' to 'React + Vite + TypeScript の SPA（Amplify で npm ビルド）'; add a local-dev section (cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev, and copying .env.example to .env.local); update the Amplify Hosting section to note the npm build, baseDirectory frontend/dist, and the API_BASE/COGNITO_DOMAIN/COGNITO_CLIENT_ID -> VITE_* mapping (same env-var names in the console); if the admin page is a client-side route (/admin), document the Amplify SPA rewrite rule (200 rewrite of all non-file paths to /index.html) and that the Cognito callback/logout URL must point to the admin route URL. Remove stale references to app.js/admin.js/config.js/'npm ビルドなし'. Do NOT change backend deploy steps.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/package.json is valid JSON declaring react, react-dom, react-router-dom, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, typescript, and the @types/* with mutually-compatible versions; no lockfile is committed.

frontend/ contains a coherent Vite React TS project: vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.node.json, index.html (root), src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/config.ts, src/api.ts, src/auth.ts, src/vite-env.d.ts, src/styles.css, src/pages/HomePage.tsx, src/pages/AdminPage.tsx, and .env.example.
src/config.ts derives API_BASE/COGNITO_DOMAIN/COGNITO_CLIENT_ID from import.meta.env.VITE_* with the exact same trailing-slash-strip and '/api' default semantics as the old app.js.

src/api.ts interfaces and request/response handling match lambda/index.ts exactly (routes, {answers:number[]}, result shapes incl. answerIndex from submit, 401/403/409/message handling, content-type guard).

src/auth.ts reproduces the Cognito Hosted UI implicit-grant flow exactly (login/logout URLs, hash capture with 60s margin + 3600 default, sessionStorage key 'quizAdminToken', history.replaceState hash strip).
Root .gitignore no longer force-tracks frontend/**; it ignores frontend/node_modules and frontend/dist while keeping frontend source tracked.

amplify.yml builds the Vite app: generates frontend/.env from the existing Amplify env vars mapped to VITE_*, runs npm ci/install + npm run build in frontend/, publishes baseDirectory frontend/dist, caches frontend/node_modules.

README.md reflects the React+Vite frontend, local dev, the Amplify npm build, the VITE_* env mapping, and (if a router path is used) the SPA rewrite rule; no dangling references to the removed vanilla files.
On the user's networked machine, `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build` would succeed and emit frontend/dist (verified by reading for correctness-by-construction in-sandbox).
verification: In-sandbox: confirm frontend/package.json and both tsconfig files are valid JSON (node -e JSON.parse or a JSON linter).
In-sandbox: read every new .ts/.tsx file and confirm imports resolve against declared deps and that API/auth code matches lambda/index.ts and the old admin.js semantics exactly.
In-sandbox: confirm amplify.yml YAML is well-formed and its env-var mapping/baseDirectory/cache are consistent with the Vite project layout.

On networked machine (documented for user): `cd frontend && env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm install && env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run build` succeeds and produces frontend/dist; root `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm ci && npm run build && npm test` still passes (backend untouched).
findings: Scaffolded the Vite+React+TS skeleton under frontend/ entirely by hand (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: npm registry returns 403, so npm install / vite build / tsc could NOT run in-sandbox). Verified correct-by-construction: package.json/tsconfig.node.json are valid JSON; tsconfig.json is valid JSONC (has comments, standard for tsconfig; parses after comment-strip); amplify.yml key structure confirmed. IMPORTANT gotcha resolved: root .gitignore's `*.d.ts` rule was ignoring frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts, so I added a `!frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts` negation and verified with `git check-ignore` + `git status --untracked-files=all` that the source file is tracked. The .gitignore `!frontend/`/`!frontend/**` force-un-ignore block was removed and replaced with ignores for frontend/node_modules, frontend/dist, frontend/.env, frontend/.env.local, frontend/*.local. amplify.yml now generates frontend/.env mapping API_BASE->VITE_API_BASE etc, runs `npm ci || npm install` + `npm run build` in frontend/, publishes frontend/dist, caches frontend/node_modules; kept the SAME Amplify console env-var names. api.ts mirrors lambda/index.ts contract exactly (routes, {answers:number[]}, submit returns answerIndex, 401->AuthError/403->'権限がありません'/message parsing/content-type guard). auth.ts mirrors admin.js Cognito implicit-grant flow exactly (STORAGE_KEY 'quizAdminToken', 60s margin, 3600 default, history.replaceState hash strip, try/catch around sessionStorage). config.ts mirrors trailing-slash strip + '/api' default. Old vanilla files (app.js/admin.js/config.js/admin.html/styles.css) intentionally LEFT for FEAT-002 to remove; frontend/index.html was intentionally overwritten with the Vite version. NOTE for host machine (env -u NODE_OPTIONS is a sandbox workaround, may be unneeded there): `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build` should succeed and emit frontend/dist.
